title: SENIOR SCHOOL
bodyText:
**The AMI School - Grade VII to O level** - adheres to the Cambridge Assessment International Examination board with the IGCSE framework. A highly interactive approach to learning is encouraged in the classrooms through discussion and group work. As part of our core school philosophy, we emphasise on open communication with parents/guardians and are deeply committed to collaborative problem solving and decision making between management, teacher and parents to the utmost benefit and well-being of our students.

For a more integrated learning environment, The AMI School focuses on learning outside the classroom through extra-curricular subjects and life skills including **Roller-Skating, Theatre, Music, Photography and Board games**. With this line-up, the goal is to ensure that children are physically, mentally and artistically stimulated and discover their unexplored skills and interests in the process.
